name: Lending Equity - Commercial and Consumer Lending

columns.name: Reporting Year
columns.description: The year in which the record was reported, covering bank operations in the previous year.

columns.name: Bank
columns.description: Name of bank submitting data for municipal depository RFP

columns.name: RFP Source
columns.description: RFP submission item data were drawn from.

columns.name: Data Description
columns.description: The specific data that the bank were required to submit.

columns.name: ZIP Code
columns.description: The ZIP Code of the properties whose loans are included in the record, if the record is aggregated by ZIP Code.

columns.name: Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract of the properties whose loans are included in the record, if the record is aggregated by Census Tract.

columns.name: Number of Loans
columns.description: The number of loans of the specified type made within the ZIP Code or Census Tract.

columns.name: Total Combined Loan Amount
columns.description: The aggregate principal amount of the loans of the specified type made within the ZIP Code or Census Tract.

columns.name: Record ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record
